# 🔤 zCaps

**Never mistype a command capitalisation again.**

CaseInsensitiveCommands is a lightweight Spigot/Paper plugin that lets players type commands in any capitalisation they want. `/SPAWN`, `/Heal`, `/tP`, `/GAMEMODE` — they all just work, exactly as if they had been typed normally.

---

## ✨ Features

- **Fully case-insensitive commands** — any capitalisation of any command is accepted
- **Arguments are never touched** — player names, messages, and other arguments stay exactly as typed
- **Zero configuration** — drop the jar in, it works
- **Tiny performance footprint** — commands already in lowercase are skipped instantly with no overhead
- **Compatible with all other plugins** — works transparently at the event level before any other plugin processes the command

---

## 💡 Why?

Mobile players, fast typers, and non-native keyboard layouts often produce accidental capitalisation when typing commands. This plugin silently corrects it so neither the player or the server ever notices.

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the jar
2. Drop it into your server's `/plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Done — no config file, no commands, no setup

---

## 🔧 Compatibility

| | |
|---|---|
| **Server** | Spigot, Bukkit, Paper, and Paper forks |
| **Minecraft** | 1.20 and above |
| **Java** | 17+ |
